recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度很高，中央一群紅血球前驅細胞緊密成團：核圓、深染、核周有清楚的透亮暈，並可見分裂相；周圍背景充滿帶紅色顆粒的嗜酸性球與分葉粒細胞。成片紅系前驅細胞群加上嗜酸性球增多，是 PCM1::JAK2 骨髓/淋巴腫瘤的特徵組合。
features: Hypercellular marrow with a large, cohesive cluster of intermediate erythroid precursors in the center
Erythroid precursors have round, centrally placed, hyperchromatic nuclei with a crisp perinuclear clear halo and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm
Several mitotic figures within the erythroid cluster
Background of numerous eosinophils with bright red granules and abundant maturing segmented granulocytes
Scattered brown-golden pigment (hemosiderin); megakaryocytes not prominent in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is markedly hypercellular with a prominent, expanded cluster of intermediate-stage erythroid precursors showing round hyperchromatic nuclei, perinuclear clearing and scattered mitoses. The surrounding marrow shows granulocytic proliferation with numerous eosinophils and maturing neutrophils, and scattered hemosiderin pigment. Blasts are not obviously increased in this field. In the appropriate context, large clusters of erythroid precursors with eosinophilia are a characteristic finding. Findings are consistent with a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PCM1::JAK2 fusion, which requires cytogenetic or molecular confirmation of t(8;9)(p22;p24.1).

ddx.dx: Chronic eosinophilic leukemia or myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1 rearrangement
ddx.vs: Share eosinophilia but lack the conspicuous large erythroid clusters; separated by FISH or RT-PCR for the specific fusion.
MPNs show atypical clustered megakaryocytes and fibrosis rather than dominant erythroid islands, and carry JAK2 V617F/CALR/MPL mutations instead of a JAK2 fusion.

ddx.dx: Acute erythroid leukemia or MDS with erythroid predominance
ddx.vs: Show proerythroblast predominance and dyserythropoiesis, usually TP53-mutated and without eosinophilia.
Erythroid islands are normally orderly and paratrabecular-sparing without associated eosinophilia or a clonal fusion.
